<h1 id="github开源生态">github开源生态</h1>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th></th>
<th></th>
<th></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>仓库名称</td>
<td>网址</td>
<td>定位与特色</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>awesome-transformer-nlp</td>
<td><a href="https://github.com/cedrickchee/awesome-transformer-nlp" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/cedrickchee/awesome-transformer-nlp</a></td>
<td>全球最受欢迎的 Transformer 资源列表，更新频率高</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>awesome-transformer (ICTNLP)</td>
<td><a href="https://github.com/ictnlp/awesome-transformer" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/ictnlp/awesome-transformer</a></td>
<td>侧重于模型实现与 WMT 翻译基准测试的可复现性</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>awesome-transformers (abacaj)</td>
<td><a href="https://github.com/abacaj/awesome-transformers" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/abacaj/awesome-transformers</a></td>
<td>聚焦于模型许可协议与模型来源，适合企业级选型</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Transformers-Recipe</td>
<td><a href="https://github.com/dair-ai/Transformers-Recipe" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/dair-ai/Transformers-Recipe</a></td>
<td>旨在提供一份“从入门到精通”的结构化学习路线图</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Awesome-Visual-Transformer</td>
<td><a href="https://github.com/dk-liang/Awesome-Visual-Transformer" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/dk-liang/Awesome-Visual-Transformer</a></td>
<td>专注于视觉 Transformer (ViT) 及其在医学成像等领域的应用</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Awesome-Transformer-Attention (视觉Transformer)</td>
<td><a href="https://github.com/cmhungsteve/Awesome-Transformer-Attention" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/cmhungsteve/Awesome-Transformer-Attention</a></td>
<td>最全面的视觉 Transformer/Attention 论文列表，包含代码和相关网站</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Awesome-Transformer-Visualization</td>
<td><a href="https://github.com/Ki-Seki/Awesome-Transformer-Visualization" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/Ki-Seki/Awesome-Transformer-Visualization</a></td>
<td>Transformer 可视化工具汇总，包括 Transformer Explainer、GemmaScope 等</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>BertViz</td>
<td><a href="https://github.com/jessevig/bertvizS" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/jessevig/bertvizS</a></td>
<td>Transformer 注意力可视化工具，支持 Head View、Model View、Neuron View 三重视图，可直观查看模型的注意力权重分布</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h1 id="官方与第三方高性能框架">官方与第三方高性能框架</h1>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th></th>
<th></th>
<th></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>框架/项目</td>
<td>网址</td>
<td>适用场景</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Tensor2Tensor (Google)</td>
<td><a href="https://github.com/tensorflow/tensor2tensor" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/tensorflow/tensor2tensor</a></td>
<td>Transformer 的官方原始实现，基于 TensorFlow</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>OpenNMT-py (Harvard)</td>
<td><a href="https://github.com/OpenNMT/OpenNMT-py" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/OpenNMT/OpenNMT-py</a></td>
<td>基于 PyTorch 的机器翻译工具包，因其高可扩展性广受好评</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Fairseq (Meta AI)</td>
<td><a href="https://github.com/facebookresearch/fairseq" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/facebookresearch/fairseq</a></td>
<td>Meta 开发的高性能序列建模工具，RoBERTa 等模型即诞生于此</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>X-Transformers</td>
<td><a href="https://github.com/lucidrains/x-transformers" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/lucidrains/x-transformers</a></td>
<td>提供简洁且功能完整的全注意力实现，适合实验性研究</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>transformers</td>
<td><a href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/huggingface/transformers</a></td>
<td>提供最先进的预训练模型，用于处理 NLP、图像及音频任务。</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h1 id="课程学习">课程学习</h1>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th></th>
<th></th>
<th></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>提供方</td>
<td>课程</td>
<td>核心技能点</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>DeepLearning.AI</td>
<td><a href="https://www.deeplearning.ai/courses/deep-learning-specialization/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://www.deeplearning.ai/courses/deep-learning-specialization/</a></td>
<td>RNN/LSTM/Transformer 的理论与实践</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Stanford</td>
<td><a href="https://web.stanford.edu/class/cs224n/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://web.stanford.edu/class/cs224n/</a><br><br><a href="https://web.stanford.edu/class/archive/cs/cs224n/cs224n.1214/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://web.stanford.edu/class/archive/cs/cs224n/cs224n.1214/</a><br><br><a href="https://web.stanford.edu/class/cs25/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://web.stanford.edu/class/cs25/</a></td>
<td>经典的深度学习自然语言处理（CS224N）课程主页，涵盖了Transformer、语言模型等前沿NLP技术与讲义。</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Hugging Face</td>
<td><a href="https://github.com/huggingface/course" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/huggingface/course</a></td>
<td>Hugging Face 官方出品的免费开源课程，基于其生态教学，覆盖 Transformer 在文本、音频等多模态任务的应用，部分课程支持中文</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>亚马逊</td>
<td><a href="https://github.com/d2l-ai/d2l-en" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/d2l-ai/d2l-en</a></td>
<td>亚马逊科学家团队维护的互动式深度学习书籍，涵盖 Transformer 理论推导与 PyTorch、TensorFlow、MXNet 多框架代码实现，被全球 500 余所名校用作教材。</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
